skin.label: All skins: which skin draws the site
skin.description: Chooses the skin that draws every page. Only Fable is available in this release, so the setting stays hidden.

show_ads.label: Ads: show advertisement slots
show_ads.description: Turn off to hide every advertisement slot at once, without emptying the regions an editor filled.

show_newsletter.label: Newsletter: show the sign-up band
show_newsletter.description: Turn off to remove the newsletter band and the buttons that point to it.

fable_footer_newsletter.label: Newsletter: show the band above the footer
fable_footer_newsletter.description: Shows the dark sign-up band above the footer; off also removes the rail and menu buttons that point to it.

fable_search_panel.label: Search: open a panel from the search buttons
fable_search_panel.description: Opens the search panel over the page; off makes the search buttons plain links to the search page.

fable_search_shortcut.label: Search: show the "/" key hint and shortcut
fable_search_shortcut.description: Shows the "/" hint on the rail's search button and lets readers press the key to open the search.

show_share.label: Share: show buttons on articles
show_share.description: Shows the share buttons on articles, at the byline and after the tags.

fable_share_facebook.label: Share: Facebook
fable_share_facebook.description: Shows a button that shares the article on Facebook.

fable_share_x.label: Share: X
fable_share_x.description: Shows a button that shares the article on X.

fable_share_pinterest.label: Share: Pinterest
fable_share_pinterest.description: Shows a button that shares the article on Pinterest.

fable_share_linkedin.label: Share: LinkedIn
fable_share_linkedin.description: Shows a button that shares the article on LinkedIn, for a business or news audience.

fable_share_whatsapp.label: Share: WhatsApp
fable_share_whatsapp.description: Shows a button that shares the article on WhatsApp, the main way stories travel on phones in many countries.

fable_share_telegram.label: Share: Telegram
fable_share_telegram.description: Shows a button that shares the article on Telegram.

fable_share_reddit.label: Share: Reddit
fable_share_reddit.description: Shows a button that shares the article on Reddit.

fable_share_email.label: Share: email
fable_share_email.description: Shows a button that opens a new email with the article's link.

fable_share_copy.label: Share: copy link
fable_share_copy.description: Shows a button that copies the article's link.

fable_share_native.label: Share: the phone's own share sheet
fable_share_native.description: Shows a button that opens the phone's own share sheet, only on devices that offer one.

fable_share_placement.label: Share: where the buttons sit
fable_share_placement.description: Puts the buttons at the byline, after the tags, in both places or in a floating column beside the article on wide screens.

optionLabels.both: At the byline and after the tags

fable_share_style.label: Share: button style
fable_share_style.description: Shows round icon buttons only, or icons with the name of each network.

fable_share_label.label: Share: line before the buttons
fable_share_label.description: The line printed before the row of buttons after the tags; leave it empty for none.

pattern.label: Pattern: icon set
pattern.description: Lays a pattern of small icons over the brand-colour areas; None keeps every area solid.

pattern_strength.label: Pattern: how visible the icons are
pattern_strength.description: Sets how strongly the icons show against the colour behind them.

pattern_density.label: Pattern: how close the icons sit
pattern_density.description: Sets how tightly the icons repeat: open, even or tight.

pattern_accent.label: Pattern: accent colour
pattern_accent.description: The colour one icon in seven takes; leave it empty to keep every icon white.

fable_pattern_colour.label: Pattern: icon colours
fable_pattern_colour.description: Chooses white icons with one accent icon in seven, all accent icons, or all white icons. It needs an accent colour.

fable_pattern_layout.label: Pattern: icon layout
fable_pattern_layout.description: Scatters and turns the icons, lays them in straight rows, or adds dots between the straight rows.

fable_pattern_style.label: Pattern: icon style
fable_pattern_style.description: Draws the icons as outlines or as solid shapes.

fable_pattern_rail.label: Pattern: show on the rail
fable_pattern_rail.description: Shows the pattern on the side rail on wide screens.

fable_pattern_phone_header.label: Pattern: show on the phone header
fable_pattern_phone_header.description: Shows the pattern on the header of small screens.

fable_pattern_footer.label: Pattern: show on the footer
fable_pattern_footer.description: Shows the pattern on the footer.

fable_pattern_long_read.label: Pattern: show on the home long read
fable_pattern_long_read.description: Shows the pattern behind the long read block on the home page.

fable_pattern_sections.label: Pattern: show on section headings
fable_pattern_sections.description: Shows the pattern behind section headings.

fable_pattern_404.label: Pattern: show behind the 404 number
fable_pattern_404.description: Shows the pattern behind the big 404 on the page-not-found screen.
